import json
from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
from rich.text import Text

def get_spans_info(text_obj):
    """Return list of (start, end, substring) for each span."""
    return [(s.start, s.end, text_obj.plain[s.start:s.end]) for s in text_obj.spans]

highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
obs = {}

# Test cases
test_cases = [
    ("adjacent", "<a>content1</a><b>content2</b>"),
    ("single", "<tag>value</tag>"),
    ("none", "plain text"),
    ("attrs", "<a href='url'>link</a>"),
    ("nested", "<a><b>inner</b></a>"),
]

for name, s in test_cases:
    txt = Text(s)
    highlighter.highlight(txt)
    spans = get_spans_info(txt)
    obs[f"c1.{name}_spancount"] = len(spans)
    obs[f"c1.{name}_spans"] = spans
    obs[f"c2.{name}_spancount"] = len(spans)
    obs[f"c2.{name}_spans"] = spans

print(json.dumps({"observations": obs}))
